chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Whoever performs the five prayers in congregation, then assume every good about him."

key_terms.جَمَاعَةً: in congregation; performed collectively with others

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about a person who regularly performs the five daily prayers in congregation?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that regular participation in the five daily salat in congregation is a sign of uprightness and religious commitment. It instructs believers to regard such a person with husn al-zann, assuming good and recognizing the social and spiritual value of communal worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Whoever prays the five daily prayers in congregation, assume every good about him."
